sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "death"."caused_by_ship_id" AS e, "ship"."location" AS g, AVG(("death"."injured" - "death"."killed")) AS m1 FROM "death" JOIN "ship" ON "ship"."id" = "death"."caused_by_ship_id"  GROUP BY "death"."caused_by_ship_id", "ship"."location"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: people injured - people killed: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one death/attack incident
average of people injured minus people killed per ship within ship.location
gap to the g average of average of people injured minus people killed (g level)
rank within the group by average of people injured minus people killed, keep the top 3
